verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا يَا نُورَ عَيْنِي ۞ مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا جَدَّ الْحُسَيْنِ
verses.tr: Marḥaban marḥaban yā nūra ʿaynī · Marḥaban marḥaban jadda-l-Ḥusayni
verses.en: Welcome, welcome, O light of my eyes! Welcome, welcome, grandfather of al-Husayn!

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ أَهْلًا ۞ مَرْحَبًا بِكَ إِنَّا بِكَ نُسْعَدْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban yā Rasūlallāhi ahlan · Marḥaban bika innā bika nusʿad
verses.en: Welcome, O Messenger of Allah, and greetings! Welcome to you — through you we are made happy.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا.. وَبِجَاهِهْ يَا إِلَهِي ۞ مَرْحَبًا.. جُدْ وَبَلِّغْ كُلَّ مَقْصَدْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban.. wa bi-jāhih yā ilāhī · Marḥaban.. jud wa balligh kulla maqṣad
verses.en: Welcome! For the sake of his high rank, O my God — welcome! — give generously and bring every aim to fulfillment.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا.. وَاهْدِنَا نَهْجَ سَبِيلِهْ ۞ مَرْحَبًا.. كَيْ بِهِ نُسْعَدْ وَنُرْشَدْ
verses.tr: Marḥaban.. wa-hdinā nahja sabīlih · Marḥaban.. kay bihi nusʿad wa nurshad
verses.en: Welcome! Guide us along the way of his path — welcome! — that through him we may find happiness and right guidance.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي يَا اللّٰه ۞ بِبَرْكَةِ الْهَادِي مُحَمَّدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Rabbi fa-ghfir lī dhunūbī yā Allāh · Bi-barakati-l-hādī Muḥammad yā Allāh
verses.en: My Lord, forgive me my sins, O Allah — by the blessing of the Guide, Muhammad, O Allah.

verses.ar: رَبِّ بَلِّغْنَا بِجَاهِهْ يَا اللّٰه ۞ فِي جِوَارِهْ خَيْرَ مَقْعَدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Rabbi ballighnā bi-jāhih yā Allāh · Fī jiwārih khayra maqʿad yā Allāh
verses.en: My Lord, for the sake of his rank bring us, O Allah, to the best of seats in his nearness, O Allah.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ تَغْشَى يَا اللّٰه ۞ أَشْرَفَ الرُّسْلِ مُحَمَّدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Wa ṣalātullāhi taghshā yā Allāh · Ashrafa-r-rusli Muḥammad yā Allāh
verses.en: And may the blessings of Allah envelop, O Allah, the noblest of messengers, Muhammad, O Allah.

verses.ar: وَسَلَامٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ يَا اللّٰه ۞ كُلَّ حِينٍ يَتَجَدَّدْ يَا اللّٰه
verses.tr: Wa salāmun mustamirrun yā Allāh · Kulla ḥīnin yatajaddad yā Allāh
verses.en: And peace unending, O Allah, renewed at every moment, O Allah.
